claims.claim: Greedy hard NMS suppresses same-category lower scored boxes whose IoU exceeds chosen threshold
claims.notes: Strict > convention and tie order are explicit local implementation choices.

claims.claim: Soft-NMS decays overlapping candidate scores instead of always deleting them
claims.notes: Minimum score and NMS mode determine returned boxes.
Not identical to IoU loss and may vary by implementations.

claims.claim: Weighted Boxes Fusion combines overlapping detection coordinates by scores
claims.notes: Typically applied to ensembles and TTA; alignment required.

claims.claim: YOLOv10 proposes consistent dual assignments for NMS-free end-to-end inference
claims.notes: One-to-many training supervision and one-to-one inference have different responsibilities.

claims.locator: Intersection-over-union definition, validated by reference lab

claims.claim: Default 0.5 threshold retains A,D,C under class-wise hard NMS
claims.notes: Cross-class D survives even though it overlaps A.

claims.claim: For IoU=8100/11900, linear Soft-NMS lowers B score 0.88 to about 0.2810
claims.notes: Floor=0.25; sigma not used for linear case.
